title: engine-issue-input.v1 — the input to the engine Issue helper
description: The structured input the engine Issue helper (issue_author.py preview/create) validates and renders into a conformant engine-labelled Issue. It carries the repository, title, and the two body sections the engine's Issue contract requires (what_this_is, whats_next), plus optional labelled references and an optional governed urgency. IMPORTANT (authority boundary): the `repository` field names the intended target, but the create path resolves the ACTUAL target from trusted engine config (the engine's own home/owned-product identity) and refuses to file if the provided value does not match the trusted-resolved target — so an input whose repository was influenced by observed content cannot redirect the filing off the engine channel. The `engine` domain label is applied by construction by the helper, never taken from this input. This schema governs the input's shape only; body rendering is issue_author.render_engine_issue_body and urgency membership mirrors telemetry's severity classes.

repository.description: The intended target repository as owner/name (for example StarshipSuperjam/engine-template). Validated by the create path against the trusted-config-resolved target; a mismatch is refused rather than filed, so this value can never steer the filing to a repository chosen by observed content.

kind.description: The canonical issue kind — the change genre this engine Issue requests. Required: the engine renders the final title as '<Kind>: <title>' from this structured value and records it as an invisible '<!-- engine-kind: … -->' body marker, so the prefix is a projection of data (never hand-authored) and the on:issues reconciler keeps it correct. This enum mirrors issue_kind.KINDS (the single source of truth); a test holds the two equal.

title.description: The Issue title's DESCRIPTIVE part only — no kind prefix. The engine renders the final title as '<Kind>: <title>' from the required 'kind' (any prefix mistyped here is stripped) and stamps the authoritative kind as an invisible body marker; the engine domain label is applied by construction and is not part of this input.

what_this_is.description: The body's 'What this is' section: what the Issue is and why it is here, in plain language. Rendered verbatim after the engine's fixed framing line.

whats_next.description: The body's 'What happens next' section: what the operator must decide or what happens next, in plain language.

references.description: Optional labelled references (each a label and a link) rendered as a references list. A bare id or a label-less/link-less entry is rejected by the renderer.

urgency.description: Optional governed urgency, restricted to telemetry's two severity classes. An out-of-set value is rejected by the renderer. Rendered as an invisible severity marker appended last. Omit for an unrated Issue (the default).

verified_head.description: Optional provenance for an Issue whose premise is committed repository state: the 'owner/repo@sha' the claim was verified against at a fresh default-branch head (StarshipSuperjam/engine-template#957). Rendered as an invisible verified-head marker before any severity marker; a malformed value is rejected by the renderer. Omit when the Issue makes no repository-state claim.
